title: All Core Devs - Testing (ACDT) #95, September 7th, 2026
agendaMarkdown:
#### Discussions

* `glamsterdam-devnet-8`: Updates?
  - Led by @qu0b.
  - Platåberget test case seems to have knocked out 12/13 Besu nodes and lagged Erigon + Ethrex nodes, brought up by @jochem-brouwer below https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2209#issuecomment-5568033889
* `glamsterdam-devnet-9`: Updates, post-mortems, planned non-finality testing not reached, unplanned non-finality tested nonetheless.  
  -  Led by @qu0b.
* `glamsterdam-devnet-11` launch: Readiness.
  -  Led by @qu0b.
    - Readiness checklist:
      - 7610 removed in [tests-glamsterdam-devnet@v8.1.3](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/releases#release-tests-glamsterdam-devnet@v8.1.3) and [tests@v20.0.2](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/releases#release-tests@v20.0.2).
      - 8037 merge-time state-gas repayment rule ([EIPs#12265](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12265)) updated in [tests-glamsterdam-devnet@v8.1.4](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/releases#release-tests-glamsterdam-devnet@v8.1.4).

#### EL breakout

* Shipping EIP-8253 with Glamsterdam? As a companion/addition EIP of EIP-7928. Shipping EIP-7928 as is is knowingly broken, see: https://gist.github.com/jochem-brouwer/72b97452ba440da909e5da5bdf876817 by @jochem-brouwer in https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2209#issuecomment-5568033889
* Benchmarking?
* Following the decision taken in ACDC last week, can we close https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12249 ?
* reorg testing
  - Brought up by @CPerezz below in https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2209#issuecomment-5567858868.
* eth/72 `txsize` is ambiguous for type-3 transactions. Details: https://github.com/ethereum/devp2p/pull/281
  - Raised by @qu0b in ACDT 94, https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2204#issuecomment-5479074806.
* https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/852 heads up: This is scheduled for RPC Standards Call (today 15 UTC!) https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2213
